text: Manchester United are best placed to sign Rafael Leao, 26, with the AC Milan and Portugal winger available for just £43m. ( Gazetta Dello Sport )
United could also explore a deal for West Ham and England forward Jarrod Bowen, 29, if the Hammers are relegated. ( Football Insider )
Chelsea have agreed to sign Argentine former Brighton left wing-back Valentin Barco, 21, from sister club Strasbourg . (Mail)

Liverpool 's Brazil goalkeeper Alisson Becker, 33, is prepared to move to Juventus and reunite with his former Roma coach Luciano Spalletti, even if the Turin club fails to secure Champions League football. (Corriere Dello Sport)

Chelsea want their former defender Thiago Silva, 41, to return to the club as a coach following his departure from Porto - but AC Milan have offered the Brazilian a one-year deal to continue playing. (ESPN Brasil)

Leeds United could move to sign Southampton midfielder Shea Charles, 22, after the Northern Ireland international missed out on a chance to reach the Premier League over the Spygate scandal. (Football Insider)

Former Arsenal centre-back Jakub Kiwior, now at Porto , has been scouted by Barcelona with the 26-year-old Poland international under consideration as the La Liga champions look for a new defender. ( Sport )

Brighton and Crystal Palace are among a number of Premier League clubs keen to sign 20-year-old Bayern Munich midfielder Arijon Ibrahimovic after the German impressed on loan at Heidenheim. ( Teamtalk )
Aston Villa are interested in Denmark striker William Osula, 22, but Newcastle insist he will not be sold after forcing his way into Eddie Howe's starting line-up. ( Football Insider )
Fenerbahce presidential candidate Hakan Safi wants to sign Marseille 's English striker Mason Greenwood, 24, as part of a 'mega package' to transform the club. ( Goal )

Barcelona have prioritised a striker this summer to replace departing Poland centre-forward Robert Lewandowski, 37, and placed Bayern Munich's England captain Harry Kane, 32, Atletico Madrid's Argentina striker Julian Alvarez, 26, and Chelsea 's Brazil forward Joao Pedro, 24, on their list of top targets. (Mundo Deportivo - in Spanish)
Manchester United have agreed a deal worth £46m (53m euros) to sign Brazilian midfielder Ederson, 26, from Atalanta . (Sport Italia - in Italian)

Ederson had looked destined to join Atletico Madrid but the Spanish club prefer another Brazilian in 25-year-old Wolves midfielder Joao Gomes, who also remains on Manchester United 's radar. (Sky Sports)
Liverpool are working on a deal for Atletico Nacional's Colombian teenager Samuel Martinez, beating Barcelona and Borussia Dortmund to sign the 17-year-old attacking midfielder. (Liverpool Echo)
Newcastle have joined Aston Villa in the race for Osasuna winger Victor Munoz, 22, with the Spaniard seen as a replacement for Bayern Munich -bound England forward Anthony Gordon, 25. (Mirror)

Everton will face competition from Bayern Munich for the signature of England defender John Stones, 31, who is available on a free transfer when his contract at Manchester City expires this summer. (Teamtalk)

Bayer Leverkusen are ready to offer Bournemouth boss Andoni Iraola an alternative to Crystal Palace should the Spaniard decide his future lies away from the Premier League when he leaves the Cherries this summer. (Telegraph - subscription required)
Roma are interested in Marseille's English forward Mason Greenwood and West Ham 's Dutch winger Crysencio Summerville, both 24. (Calciomercato - in Italian)

Bournemouth are lining up a move for Sporting's Ivory Coast centre-back Ousmane Diomande, 22, as a replacement for 29-year-old Argentina defender Marcos Senesi, 29, who will leave the Cherries when his contract expires. (Football Insider)
Newcastle , Aston Villa , Leeds United , Brighton and Crystal Palace have all been made aware of the availability of Juventus' Canadian striker Jonathan David, 26. (Teamtalk)
Chelsea have joined Arsenal in the race for Bournemouth 's French forward Eli Junior Kroupi, but the Cherries insist the 19-year-old is not for sale. (Mail)

Fulham 's 29-year-old Wales midfielder Harry Wilson is among the players on Aston Villa manager Unai Emery's summer shopping list after being given a £100m transfer budget following the club's Europa League triumph. (Mirror)
Everton are also interested in Wilson, who will be available on a free transfer when his contract ends in June. (Sky Sports)

Manchester United are confident of sealing the double transfer of Atalanta's 26-year-old Brazil midfielder Ederson and Newcastle 's Italy midfielder Sandro Tonali, also 26, this summer. (Sky Sports Italy - in Italian)
Brighton are in talks with Olympiacos to sign 26-year-old Portuguese right-back Costinha for about £11m. (Athletic - subscription required)

Arsenal and Juventus are monitoring Manchester City 's 27-year-old midfielder Tijjani Reijnders, with the Netherlands international having limited playing time since his arrival last summer. (Teamtalk)
Newcastle will target Porto's 21-year-old Belgian forward Matias Fernandez-Pardo if England forward Anthony Gordon, 25, leaves the club this summer. (Mail - subscription required)
Manchester United view Newcastle left-back Lewis Hall as a leading option for next season, while Bayern Munich and Liverpool are also interested in the 21-year-old England international. (Teamtalk)
Inter Milan are considering making a move for Arsenal 's 31-year-old Spain goalkeeper Kepa Arrizabalaga. (Gazzetta - in Italian)

Xabi Alonso's appointment as Chelsea manager could scupper Atletico Madrid's hopes of signing Marc Cucurella, 27, with the 44-year-old keen to keep hold of the Spain defender. (Mundo Deportivo - in Spanish)
Arsenal 's 24-year-old Netherlands defender Jurrien Timber is set to be rewarded with a new contract by the club. (Caught Offside)
Liam Delap is edging closer to exiting Chelsea , with Everton in pole position to sign the 23-year-old English striker. (Football Insider)
Pep Guardiola's impending exit from Manchester City opens the door for 29-year-old Spain midfielder Rodri to join Real Madrid this summer. (Marca - in Spanish)
Bayern Munich are considering a shock move for England defender John Stones with the 31-year-old set to leave Manchester City at the end of the season. (Mail)
Atletico Madrid are weighing up moves for Manchester City 's 31-year-old Portugal midfielder Bernardo Silva and Chelsea 's 27-year-old Spain defender Marc Cucurella. (Sky Sports)
Inter Miami are closing in on the signing of Manchester United 's Brazil midfielder Casemiro with the 34-year-old set to leave the club at the end of the season. (Athletic)
Liverpool 's 33-year-old Brazil goalkeeper Alisson wants to join Juventus this summer even if the Serie A side fail to qualify for the Champions League. (Gazzetta - in Italian)

Barcelona have agreed personal terms with 28-year-old England forward Marcus Rashford as they look to make his loan deal permanent, but are yet to agree a transfer fee with Manchester United . (Sport - in Spanish)

Liverpool have formally registered their interest in 20-year-old Hoffenheim winger Bazoumana Toure but they face competition from Manchester United , Aston Villa and Newcastle who also admire the Ivorian. (Teamtalk)
Manchester United are monitoring Borussia Dortmund left-back Julian Ryerson, 28, with the Norway international being lined up as a possible replacement for Noussair Mazraoui. (Sky Sports Germany)
Manchester United could take advantage of Southampton's Spygate controversy by moving for 22-year-old Northern Ireland midfielder Shea Charles. (Mirror)
Liverpool could make a move for 21-year-old Norway winger Antonio Nusa should a deal for his RB Leipzig team-mate Yan Diomande become too difficult. (Football Insider)
Fenerbahce have emerged as a surprise contender to sign 33-year-old Egypt forward Mohamed Salah from Liverpool this summer. (Caught Offside)
Chelsea are weighing up a move for Bayer Leverkusen centre-back Edmond Tapsoba, 27, with the Burkina Faso international having previously worked under incoming boss Xabi Alonso. (Teamtalk)
Borussia Dortmund are unlikely to bring Manchester United 's 26-year-old England winger Jadon Sancho, who is on loan at Aston Villa , back to the club for a third spell. (Bild - in German)

Chelsea , Liverpool and Manchester United are interested in England forward Jarrod Bowen, 29, as rival clubs prepare to capitalise on West Ham 's financial problems if they are relegated by targeting their best players. (Guardian)

Barcelona have cooled their interest in Atletico Madrid's Argentina striker Julian Alvarez, 26, and will instead pursue a move for 24-year-old Chelsea and Brazil forward Joao Pedro. (Mundo Deportivo - in Spanish)
Manchester City boss Pep Guardiola has endorsed Enzo Maresca's appointment as his successor, with the Italian courted by AC Milan , Tottenham and Real Madrid since he left Chelsea . (Talksport)
Spaniard Guardiola will take a year-long sabbatical after leaving Manchester City before taking a job coaching a national team. (Sport - in Spanish)
Benfica want Fulham boss Marco Silva to take over from Real Madrid -bound Jose Mourinho, with former Manchester United manager Ruben Amorim also a candidate for the role. (A Bola - in Portuguese)
Roma's Argentine forward Paulo Dybala, 32, is open to a move to the Premier League this summer. (Sky Sports)
Atletico Madrid and Borussia Dortmund are battling to sign Brighton and Denmark midfielder Matt O'Riley, with Tottenham boss Roberto de Zerbi also a fan of the 25-year-old. (Teamtalk)
Real Madrid will consider selling Uruguay midfielder Federico Valverde, 27, this summer. (Mundo Deportivo - in Spanish)

Everton 's interest in FC Midtjylland's Chile winger Dario Osorio, 22, is unlikely to impact a deal being done for 30-year-old England attacker Jack Grealish following his loan spell from Manchester City . (Football Insider)
Everton have also reignited their interest in 22-year-old Leicester City and Ghana forward Abdul Fatawu. (Teamtalk)
Returning Real Madrid boss Jose Mourinho wants to sign England forward Marcus Rashford, 28, who is on loan at La Liga champions Barcelona from Manchester United . (Sport - in Spanish)
Everton and Aston Villa are interested in Newcastle 's 22-year-old Denmark forward William Osula. (The I)
England centre-back Levi Colwill, 23, is not currently in talks over an improved contract at Chelsea , however, discussions could resume in the summer. (Sky Sports)
Manchester United and Chelsea are both interested in signing Germany forward Karim Adeyemi this summer, with Borussia Dortmund willing to sell the 24-year-old for the right price. (Teamtalk)
Netherlands centre-back Lutsharel Geertruida, 25, on loan at Sunderland from RB Leipzig, is keen to continue playing in the Premier League next season amid interest from Everton . (Football Insider)

Real Madrid and Germany defender Antonio Rudiger, 33, will sign a one-year contract to stay at the Bernabeu but the club remain interested in a proposal to sign Manchester City 's 24-year-old Croatian defender Josko Gvardiol. (AS - in Spanish)
English goalkeeper Tom Heaton, 40, is poised to sign a one-year contract extension to stay at Manchester United for a sixth season. (Mirror)
Liverpool are plotting a move to sign 30-year-old Inter Milan and Netherlands defender Denzel Dumfries to bolster their options at right-back. (Football Insider)
Chelsea have an interest in Aston Villa attacking midfielder Morgan Rogers but Arsenal , Manchester United and Paris St-Germain are also looking at the 23-year-old England international. (Talksport)

Barcelona, who are reluctant to pay the 30m euros to turn Manchester United forward Marcus Rashford's loan move into a permanent deal, are aware Aston Villa are keen on the 28-year-old England international. (Mundo Deportivo - in Spanish)
Chelsea are targeting a keeper and are seriously considering a move for Sunderland 's 23-year-old Dutchman Robin Roefs. (Mirror)
Spain midfielder Rodri, 29, has one year left on his Manchester City contract but says he is calm about his future as he focuses on the end of the season with his club. (Marca - in Spanish)
Arsenal are believed to be open to selling Brazil striker Gabriel Jesus for £30m, with the 29-year-old having been linked with AC Milan and Juventus. (Caught Offside)
Brentford have joined Brighton and Chelsea in showing an interest in Cologne's 19-year-old German winger Said El Mala. (Mail)
Leeds United want to extend Wales midfielder Ethan Ampadu's contract with the club and expect the 25-year-old to agree as he is also keen on a new deal. (Football Insider)
Napoli boss Antonio Conte has hinted he might leave the club at the end of the season having secured Champions League qualification for the Serie A side. (Football Italia)
Lazio boss Maurizio Sarri has been linked with taking over from Conte at Napoli and says he is "far from happy" that he "wasn't listened to at all" by his current club. (Football Italia)

Juventus plan to step up their efforts to sign Portugal attacking midfielder Bernardo Silva, who will leave Manchester City in the summer, as they try to beat Atletico Madrid and Barcelona to the 31-year-old's signature. (Corriere dello Sport - in Italian)
Barcelona sporting director Deco was expected at the FA Cup Final to watch Chelsea striker Joao Pedro, despite the Blues not wanting to sell the 24-year-old Brazil international. (Mail)

Premier League newcomers Coventry City are weighing up a deal for 35-year-old Netherlands midfielder Georginio Wijnaldum, whose contract with Al-Ettifaq is set to run out in the summer. (Football Insider)
Everton are keen on signing a winger in the summer and are monitoring Burnley 's 22-year-old Loum Tchaouna, who has represented the France Under-21 team. (Football Insider)

Leeds United forward Wilfried Gnonto, 22, is wanted by German club SC Freiburg and the Elland Road club are open to the Italy international being sold or leaving on a loan with an obligation to buy. (Sky Sports Germany)

Italy defender Alessandro Bastoni, 27, has been heavily linked with Barcelona but would be happy to stay at Inter Milan if a move to the Spanish club does not materialise. (Gazzetta dello Sport - in Italian)
Juventus could decide to give Brazil midfielder Douglas Luiz, who is on loan at Aston Villa , another chance to impress unless they manage to sell the 28-year-old. (Gazzetta dello Sport - in Italian)

Bayern Munich have an interest in 25-year-old Atalanta and Belgium forward Charles De Ketelaere but only as an alternative if a move for Newcastle United 's England winger Anthony Gordon, 25, fails. (Football Italia)
Newcastle United are holding out for their £75m valuation of England winger Anthony Gordon as Bayern Munich close in on agreeing a five-year deal with the 25-year-old. (Times - subscription required)

Liverpool retain confidence in striker Alexander Isak, 26, and are looking at 19-year-old Ivory Coast winger Yan Diomande and 21-year-old Norway forward Antonio Nusa, who both play for RB Leipzig, as well as 23-year-old France forward Bradley Barcola, who is at Paris St-Germain, as possible options to help bring the best out of the Sweden international. (The i Paper)
Arne Slot's side could also target Sunderland 's Robin Roefs, 23, should first-choice goalkeeper Alisson, 33, move to Juventus . ( Caught Offside )
Italian defender Michael Kayode has been linked with the Turin side but the 21-year-old says he is happy at Brentford and not thinking about leaving the London club. (Tuttosport, via Football Italia)
France midfielder Eduardo Camavinga, 23, could look to leave Real Madrid after being left out of France's World Cup squad, with Tottenham known to be interested. ( Teamtalk )
Roberto de Zerbi's side will also move for Monaco's France midfielder Maghnes Akliouche, 24, if he is made available for transfer. ( Football Insider )
Inter Milan defender Denzel Dumfries, 30, will be available for 25m euros when a clause in the Dutch international's contract kicks in for a limited time in July. (Gazzetta dello Sport - in Italian)

Nottingham Forest are planning to give manager Vitor Pereira a new long-term contract. The Portuguese took over on an 18-month deal in February and has guided the club to Premier League safety. (Athletic - subscription required)
Paris St-Germain are among the clubs interested in 21-year-old West Ham and Portugal midfielder Mateus Fernandes. (Athletic - subscription required)

Arsenal are also interested in Fernandes and are open to selling Denmark midfielder Christian Norgaard, 32, who hasn't made an impact since joining from Brentford last summer. (The Times - subscription required)

Uruguay midfielder Federico Valverde wants to stay at Real Madrid but, Manchester City and Paris St-Germain are waiting in the wings, if the Spanish club decide to sell the 27-year-old. (AS - in Spanish)

Aston Villa want to sign Argentine forward Matias Soule, 23, from Roma after the conditions for 27-year-old Dutch winger Donyell Malen's loan move from the Midlands side to the Italian club to turn into a permanent switch were triggered. (Gazzetta dello Sport - in Italian)

Chelsea are targeting a move for AC Milan keeper Mike Maignan but the Stamford Bridge club's hopes of landing the 30-year-old France international could be hindered if they do not secure a Champions League spot. (Gazzetta dello Sport - in Italian)
Brazil international Joao Pedro has been linked with Barcelona but Chelsea have no intention of selling the 24-year-old striker. (Mail)
Bayer Leverkusen are set to sack manager Kasper Hjulmand, who took over from Erik ten Hag in September. (Sky Sports Germany)

Porto president Andre Villas Boas says it is "financially impossible" for the club to sign 37-year-old Poland forward Robert Lewandowski, who has been linked with a move away from Barcelona . (Fabrizio Romano)
Everton , Crystal Palace and Bournemouth have approached FC Midtjylland in pursuit of 22-year-old Chile midfielder Dario Osorio. (Give Me Sport)
Manchester United are monitoring Sporting Lisbon and Denmark midfielder Morten Hjulmand, 26, who is also on Arsenal 's radar. (Caught Offside)

Middlesbrough midfielder Hayden Hackney, 23, is set to leave the Riverside club if their defeat to Southampton in the Championship play-off semi-final stands, and Newcastle United could make a move for the English player. (Chronicle)
Bayern Munich have reached an agreement with Anthony Gordon and have begun negotiations with Newcastle United over signing the England forward, 25. (Bild - in German)
Chelsea and Manchester United have Real Sociedad's 24-year-old Spain forward Ander Barrenetxea on their list of potential signings this summer. (Marca - in Spanish)
Manchester United are ready to make a formal move for Nottingham Forest 's England midfielder Elliot Anderson, 23. (Give Me Sport)
Chelsea and Galatasaray are interested in signing 23-year-old English forward Jonathan Rowe from Bologna . (Gazzetta dello Sport - in Italian)
Germany forward Nick Woltemade is unhappy at Newcastle and Atletico Madrid are among the clubs monitoring the 24-year-old's situation. (Bild - in German)
Former England forward Mason Greenwood, 24, plans to stay at Marseille despite being linked with top European clubs such as Juventus , Borussia Dortmund and Atletico Madrid . (Sun)
Marseille will not utilise their purchase option for 30-year-old France defender Benjamin Pavard, who is currently on loan from Inter Milan . (Bild - in German)
Tottenham are looking at a summer move for Sassuolo's £30m-rated Bosnia-Herzegovina defender Tarik Muharemovic, 23. (Caught Offside)
Ivory Coast winger Yan Diomande, who will reportedly cost £80m, has been linked to Chelsea and Liverpool but the 19-year-old is in no rush to leave RB Leipzig . (The Athletic - subscription required)
Leeds are tracking Belgium forward Lois Openda, who is set to join Juventus from RB Leipzig , but the Italian club are hoping to move on the 26-year-old following a poor loan spell. (TeamTalk)
Premier League sides West Ham and Crystal Palace are keeping tabs on 21-year-old Pape Moussa Fall, a 6ft 6in Senegalese striker who is on loan at Belgian side RAAL La Louviere from Metz . (TeamTalk)
Manchester United are looking for a permanent home for 30-year-old Cameroon goalkeeper Andre Onana, who has been on loan at Turkish side Trabzonspor . (ESPN)
United are also ready to offer a new deal to 40-year-old third-choice goalkeeper Tom Heaton. (Caught Offside)
Manchester United are weighing up a shock move for Real Madrid's Uruguay midfielder Federico Valverde, 27. (Star)
Paris St-Germain have made Atletico Madrid's Argentina striker Julian Alvarez, 26, one of their main targets for next season. (ESPN)
Manchester United have stepped up their interest in Atalanta's Brazil midfielder Ederson, 26, and West Ham 's Portugal midfielder Mateus Fernandes, 21. (Sky Sports)
Ben White could turn down a move to Everton this summer if the England defender, 28, receives assurances about his playing time at Arsenal . (Football Insider)
Real Madrid are unsure whether to trigger a buy-back clause for Como's Spanish defender Jacobo Ramon this summer, so Chelsea could have a chance to sign the 21-year-old. (Sun)
Belgium midfielder Youri Tielemans, 29, could be set to leave Aston Villa at the end of the season. (Football Insider)
England forward Jarrod Bowen, 29, could remain with West Ham even if they are relegated from the Premier League. (Teamtalk)
Porto have a concrete interest in signing Robert Lewandowski on a free transfer this summer but the 37-year-old Poland striker could still sign a new deal with Barcelona . (Florian Plettenberg)
Despite helping Nottingham Forest avoid relegation, manager Vitor Pereira could be replaced by Fulham boss Marco Silva this summer. (Teamtalk)

Bournemouth manager Andoni Iraola has been ruled out of contention for the Manchester United job as Michael Carrick edges closer to being appointed on a permanent basis, leaving Iraola free to discuss the vacancies at Crystal Palace and Chelsea . (Mail - subscription required)
Chelsea have held initial talks with ex- Real Madrid coach Xabi Alonso, and contacted Andoni Iraola and Marco Silva. (Times - subscription required)
Three Premier League clubs - Liverpool , Newcastle , and Everton - are targeting England forward Jarrod Bowen, 29, even if West Ham avoid relegation. (Mail)

Juventus are considering a loan move for Chelsea forward Nicolas Jackson. The Senegal international, 24, is on loan at Bayern Munich but will not stay at the German champions next season. (Bild - in German)

Liverpool are interested in Monaco's 24-year-old right winger Maghnes Akliouche, with the France international valued around €50m (£43m). His team-mate Lamine Camara is also on Liverpool 's radar, but they may face competition from Newcastle for the 22-year-old Senegal midfielder. (L'Equipe, in French – subscription required)
Real Madrid will likely need to sell players before bringing in any new faces, with Spain midfielder Dani Ceballos, 29, among those they could look to offload. (The Athletic – subscription required)
West Ham have put a price tag of £84m on 21-year-old Portugal midfielder Mateus Fernandes, who has attracted interest from the likes of Manchester United and Paris St-Germain . (Football Insider)
Manchester United are considering a move for Atalanta and Brazil midfielder Ederson, 26, who could be available for around £40m. (Manchester Evening News)
Barcelona manager Hansi Flick has agreed a new contract running until 2028, with the option to extend for a further year. (Mundo Deportivo - in Spanish)
Manchester United are expected to be busy in the transfer window as they target at least five signings, including three central midfielders, a left-back and a striker. (Sun)

Two Ligue 1 goalkeepers have emerged as potential replacements for Emi Martinez, with Aston Villa considering Lens' Robin Risser and Toulouse's Guillaume Restes - both 21-year-old France youth internationals - if the Argentine leaves this summer. (Foot Mercato – in French)
Sporting and Portugal midfielder Francisco Trincao, 26, is attracting attention from Liverpool and Chelsea . (Caught Offside)
Sunderland and DR Congo midfielder Noah Sadiki, 21, has not ruled out leaving the Stadium of Light this summer. (Voetbal Nieuws - in Dutch)
Everton have been in talks with John Stones over the England defender, 31, returning to the club when he leaves Manchester City this summer. (Football Insider)
Manchester United have dismissed suggestions that Ivory Coast winger Amad Diallo, 23, could be allowed to leave this summer. (Teamtalk)
Newcastle are closing in on tying down English midfielder Lewis Miley, 20, to a long-term contract. (Sun)
Italy full-back Andrea Cambiaso has emerged as an option for Arsenal , Liverpool and Manchester United as Juventus could make the 26-year-old available for transfer this summer. (Teamtalk)
Atletico Madrid remain interested in signing Brazil midfielder Joao Gomes from Wolves but will not pay more than 40m euros (£34.7m) for the 25-year-old. (Marca - in Spanish)
Scottish midfielder Bailey Rice, 19, is set to leave Rangers this summer and Aston Villa are among the Premier League clubs interested in signing him. (Football Insider)
Liverpool have spoken to Real Madrid about Xabi Alonso's brief tenure with the Spanish club as they consider whether their former midfielder is a future managerial candidate. (AS - in Spanish)
Ipswich Town are are drawing up a list of candidates in case manager Kieran McKenna is offered another Premier League job this summer. (Sun)
Arsenal and Manchester United will miss out on Wolves midfielder Joao Gomes, 25, as the Brazil international is close to agreeing a deal with Atletico Madrid. (Sun)
Bayern Munich and Real Madrid have contacted the representatives of Croatia defender Josko Gvardiol, 24, regarding his contract situation at Manchester City . (Teamtalk)
Paris St-Germain boss Luis Enrique, 56, is close to agreeing a new contract with the French giants. The Spaniard is said to be close to signing a new four-year deal. (Sunday Mirror)
Liverpool are interested in Aston Villa and Argentina goalkeeper Emi Martinez, 33, should Brazil international Allison depart. (Tuttojuve - in Italian)
Arsenal are willing to sell English forward Ethan Nwaneri, 19, in the summer transfer window, with Chelsea one of the clubs interested. (Fabrizio Romano, on YouTube)
Real Madrid are in talks with the agent of Jose Mourinho about the possibility of appointing the 63-year-old Benfica boss as their next head coach. (Athletic - subscription required)
Former Chelsea and Manchester United manager Mourinho, who has been contacted directly by Real, is reportedly demanding full control and a significant say in transfers. (Sky Germany)
Newcastle and Chelsea are interested in ex- Liverpool striker Darwin Nunez, with the 26-year-old Uruguayan possibly set to leave Saudi Arabian side Al-Hilal . (Daily Star)
Arsenal , Liverpool , Bayern Munich and Barcelona are all keen on 23-year-old Paris St-Germain and France winger Bradley Barcola. (Mundo Deportivo - in Spanish)
Atletico Madrid are close to agreeing a deal for Wolves ' Brazilian midfielder Joao Gomes, 25, worth about £39m. (Givemesport)
Inter Milan are considering abandoning their pursuit of Tottenham 's Italian goalkeeper Guglielmo Vicario, 29, in order to strengthen other areas of their squad. (Corriere dello Sport - in Italian)
Leeds remain favourites to sign Juventus striker Lois Openda this summer despite interest from Coventry City in the 26-year-old Belgium international. (Football Insider)

Newcastle are set to overhaul their recruitment department and will appoint scouts to cover new markets such as the Balkans, while former Magpies striker Shola Ameobi is set to leave his role as the club's loans manager. (The i)
Manchester City are contenders to sign Real Madrid and Brazil forward Vinicius Jr, with just over a year left on the 25-year-old's contract at the Bernebau. (Teamtalk)
Bayern Munich have made contact with Newcastle United over a move for England winger Anthony Gordon, 25, but there is a £20m gap in valuations between the clubs. (Mail - subscription required)
France forward Bradley Barcola could leave Paris St-Germain in the summer, with Arsenal , Liverpool and Barcelona interested in the 23-year-old. (Sky Sports Germany)

Tottenham boss Roberto de Zerbi wants to trigger the option Spurs have to turn 30-year-old Portugal midfielder Joao Palhinha's loan move from Bayern Munich into a permanent switch for £27m. (Mail - subscription required)

Barcelona have a limit of about 100m euros (£86.5m) to sign Argentina striker Julian Alvarez from Atletico Madrid but are waiting to see if the 26-year-old pushes for a move before attempting any transfer. (Mundo Deportivo - in Spanish)
Serbia striker Dusan Vlahovic, 26, will be out of contract at Juventus this summer and is waiting for Barcelona or Bayern Munich to try to sign him. (Sportmediaset, via Football Italia)
Manchester City are in talks with 24-year-old Croatia defender Josko Gvardiol about extending his contract with the club. (Sky Sports)
Brighton , Leeds United and West Ham could try to scupper Brentford 's move for 19-year-old RB Salzburg's Austrian defender Jannik Schuster. (Teamtalk)
Everton will have to step up their efforts to sign Burnley defender Maxime Esteve as Bayer Leverkusen are keen on the 23-year-old Frenchman. (Football Insider)
German club Eintracht Frankfurt are considering parting ways with manager Albert Riera, with the former Liverpool and Spain winger only appointed in January. (Sky Sports Germany)
Manchester United have no plans to reintegrate England forward Marcus Rashford, 28, into their first-team squad next season if he returns from his loan at Barcelona. (Sun)
Meanwhile, Rashford remains determined to continue his spell with the Spanish club and play under manager Hansi Flick, despite uncertainty over his long-term future at United. (Teamtalk)
Real Madrid are considering a return for former manager Jose Mourinho , but his current club Benfica want him to stay for at least one more season. (AS - in Spanish)
Arsenal and Barcelona are interested in Chelsea midfielder Enzo Fernandez, 25, though they face competition from Manchester City for the Argentina international. (Teamtalk)

Newcastle will make signing a new goalkeeper one of their priorities this summer after identifying the position as a weakness, with Manchester City and England's James Trafford and Brighton and Netherlands' Bart Verbruggen, both 23, among the targets. (Telegraph - subscription required)
Arsenal are planning significant player sales in this summer's transfer window despite banking more than £120m in Uefa prize money from their run to the Champions League final. (Sky Sports)
Brentford are working to sign 19-year-old Austrian defender Jannik Schuster from Red Bull Salzburg in a deal worth £17m. (Athletic)
Tottenham are targeting Brighton 's Jan Paul van Hecke, 25, though Chelsea and Liverpool are also interested in the Netherlands centre-back. (Teamtalk)
Chelsea defender Wesley Fofana has been offered to Barcelona by the 25-year-old Frenchman's representative. (Sky France)

Napoli say they will sign on-loan Manchester United striker Rasmus Hojlund, 23, on a permanent deal. The Serie A side are close to securing a Champions League spot which would trigger a £38m fee for the Denmark forward. (Mirror)

West Ham attacker Crysencio Summerville, 24, is being monitored by a number of clubs across Europe, with the Dutch winger's asking price set to drop if the Hammers are relegated. (Telegraph - subscription required)
Former Barcelona boss Xavi Hernandez is under consideration by Chelsea to be their next manager. (Independent)
Tottenham and Italy goalkeeper Guglielmo Vicario, 29, and Liverpool 's England midfielder Curtis Jones, 25, are on Inter Milan's radar. (Gazzetta dello Sport - in Italian)
Liverpool boss Arne Slot is set to stay at the club, despite Ajax being interested in the Dutchman. (Mirror)

Liverpool are weighing up a move for 28-year-old Bournemouth and Argentina defender Marco Senesi, who has verbally agreed to join Tottenham if they avoid relegation from the Premier League. (Talksport)

Barcelona are interested in Bournemouth 's 19-year-old forward Junior Kroupi but will face competition from Manchester City and several other Premier League clubs for the France Under-21 international. (Sky Sports)
